row.notes: fills out (0x288 bytes: LineupChange[40] at +0, u64 count at +0x280, zeroed first) with the drivers whose team or race-seat status differs between the current entrant vector object (entity+0x2d8: {allocator, begin, end}) and a baseline one (weekend+0x18, the weekend from vtable slot +0xa0 of the signing's weekend source); race seat = team set, team_position < 2 and its has-position byte set. Called by the Driver Career signing (0x140d7849e) and the season processor (0x140db4e1d) right before posting the three MessageDriverMovesFinalised messages; reads only

verify.notes: V0880 sigcheck OK. Proto right: rcx out, rdx current, r8 baseline, returns out. The signing passes rcx = rsp+0x70, rdx = [comp+0x278] + 0x2d8, r8 = ([comp+0x270] vt+0xa0)() + 0x18 (0x140d78476..0x140d7849e); both vectors are read at +8/+0x10 with 0x88 stride; race seat = team stat != 0x3fff, byte +0x80 < 2 and +0x81 set; capacity 40 (at 0x28 it only TRACE-logs); count at +0x280; only out is written. Quibbles: only the count is zeroed first (entries past count are not cleared, and the signing does not clear the buffer); each 0x10 entry also holds the replaced driver key at +0xc (TRACE 'replaced driver', 0x3fff0000 if none); the season-processor xref 0x140db4e1d is the rel32 of the call at 0x140db4e1c, and that caller passes stack vector copies, not entity+0x2d8
